plain: Training a reasoning model to read the written safety rules and think about them before it answers.
eli5: Teaching a kid to stop and remember the house rules before doing something, instead of only learning from being told off.
technical: OpenAI (2024): fine-tune a reasoning model on chains of thought that quote and apply a written safety specification, then RL against a judge that sees the spec, so the policy reasons explicitly over the rules at inference time.
